snippet.title: Darkbound - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Demo Release Date Trailer for Darkbound, a retro survival horror game developed by Milmotes. Players will embody a cat to solve puzzles and help others to escape a sinister hospital. Darkbound is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on July 1.
